structured_output.summary:
room-15 (master bath) now places nothing: its 17 writes all landed on air the shell owns, so runParts refused them. The layout is kept in the file as data, with the layers() call switched off.
make.sh runs clean for this part (no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE) and writes build.nbt; the roof's OFF-PALETTE line belongs to roof.json, not this part.
The bath stays bare until the shell stops writing air over its own interiors (parts/shell.mjs:27, box() fills air across x27..68 z43..60 y4..16).
left: Blocked on the shell, not this part: shell.mjs's box() fills every interior cell with air, and runParts counts that air as owned. So every room part is refused the same way; room-15's layout (basin, tub, rug, table, barrels, lanterns) can be re-enabled once the shell stops claiming the room air, or the lock stops counting air.
To re-enable: restore the layers(g, origin, legend, layersByY) call in parts/room-15.mjs and delete the three `void` lines.

Roof (not this part): roof.json gives OFF-PALETTE tuff_brick_slab, tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, tuff_brick_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_stairs, stone_brick_slab. Left for the roof owner.
